conventions: stage px (1920 x 1080 / 1080 x 2340), y down; t = the menu clock (MenuV6Clock, unscaled); idle = landscape.html#demo=0 (the product); story = #dread&demo=0 (the story beat: d0 2.8 s, tiers 1-3; the sky-lid apparition is story-only, CRACKS §3); a formula's code is the page's own text (src = file:lines)

formulas.code:
const ds0 = MP.dreadState;
  MP.dreadState = function (t, D) { const S = ds0.call(this, t, D); if (S.apparU > -1 && S.apparU < 8) S.lid = win(S.apparU, .6, 1.3, 2.6, 3.1); return S; };
const V4 = { DREAD: HP.has('dread'), whisper: 19.7, d0: 2.8 };

director.chain: menu_v4 dreadState -> menu_v41 (bindDraw / bindA / bindCool, drop = max(.16 whisper, .34 omen, .82 appar)) -> menu_v5 (bind = bindDraw = bindA = bindCool = kin = 0) -> anime_v61_eye (lid = win(apparU, .6, 1.3, 2.6, 3.1) while -1 < apparU < 8)

idle.omen: omenU = t - 8 - 70 n - 20 hash2(n, 1, 3), n = floor((t - 8) / 70), for t > 8: the n-th omen starts at 8 + 70 n + 20 hash2(n, 1, 3) (first 18.468 s)
idle.specNote: SPEC §8.3 "every 11 s from 5.2 s" is the v2 / v3 text: the v6.3 page runs the ladder at these times (menu_v4.js:59-60). The page is the approved truth.

story.tiers: u = t - 2.8: tier 1 u < 5, 2 u < 9, 3 after; whisperU = u - 2.6, omenU = u - 5, apparU = u - 9

director.check: p5/dread_model.py ports this chain: == the page at 30 Hz over idle 0-600 s and story 0-30 s, every column, max error 0 (check/dread_model.json)

torch.what: the torch gutters: flame alpha E.bg (1 - .55 sg), size (1.9 | 1.6) k (1 - .25 sg); its pool (1 - .6 sg) / (1 - .5 sg); the flicker x (1 - .75 sg); the warm rake (1 - .6 sg)

code.code: drawFlame(g, tl.x, tl.y, t, E.bg * (1 - .55 * sg), (L.torch.stand ? 1.9 : 1.6) * L.k * (1 - .25 * sg));

stone.what: the Stone darkens: #0a0414 at .3 sg over the Stone rect minus the breach (evenodd): mask stone_minus_breach

bloomPylons.what: the violet bloom from S2(250, -280) (additive radial 40 k .. 900 k, stops .18 sg / .11 sg / 0) and the pylons: rgba(4,2,8,.2 sg) over each L.panels rect grown 12 px

code.code:
if (sg > .01) { g.save(); const [bx2, by2] = S2([250, -280]); const sv = g.createRadialGradient(bx2, by2, 40 * L.k, bx2, by2, 900 * L.k); sv.addColorStop(0, `rgba(120,60,200,${.18 * sg})`); sv.addColorStop(.5, `rgba(60,24,110,${.11 * sg})`); sv.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.fillStyle = sv; g.fillRect(0, 0, W, H); g.restore();
      g.save(); g.fillStyle = `rgba(4,2,8,${.2 * sg})`; for (const P of L.panels) g.fillRect(P.x - 12, P.y - 12, P.w + 24, P.h + 24); g.restore(); } // the pylons darken too

vignette.what: the vignette pressure pr += .3 sg (P1 vignette units)

grade.what: the grade (drop): radial from S2(0,0) 150 k -> 330 k to rgba(6,4,14,d) + the top band to L.nut.top + 10 at .5 d, everywhere but the breach front + the sky-lid hole; inside the breach x (1 - spare), spare = max(surf, bind) (bind 0 in v5); the crack breaks are cut out of it (gaps at ea, the whole break spared 35 %: CRK.wrapDrop)

breach.what: the breach under the ladder: breathe br = 1 + .006 sin(t 2pi / 8.3) + .005 sin(t 2pi / 6.1 + 1) + .02 omen (the hole path scaled about H.c); lit = 1 - .45 sg; lids opK; the deep eyes px x (1 + .3 omen), open opK (1 - .8 surf); the master eye grows 1 + .1 omen + .24 surf about H.c; tendrils lerp(rest, omen len, eOut(max(omen, surf, whisper .25))) and recoil max(push, door hover .5); crack glow x (1 + .7 sg); fissure glow x (1 + .6 sg); the fissure lens opens op = max(omen, .6 surf) (1 - push) with his eye at 170 k inside; the ink blot (whisper); the smoke mouth (omen)

eyes.what: his eye plan: reveals, the fissure lens, the Puzzle flare squeeze (omenU .75-1.35, apparU 4.3-4.9: close, hold, the ep.1 open), stillness, idle blinks (quiet near reveals / omens); breach eyes open >= .82; breach eyes drawn at .8 about the ball centre (drawBreachHole wrapper); eye61State p = S.p x clamp(open (1 - .55 squeeze)); lit < 1 darkens by #050207 at (1 - lit) .85 source-atop (Unity: vertex colour x (1 - .85 (1 - lit)), <= 6 levels off)

nut.what: Nut's sky fracture runs to its end on the omen / apparition: E = L lerp(riftRun, 1, run), open = 1 + .03 sin(tc 2pi / 5.3 + seed) + .4 max(omen, .6 appar) (P2 nut net)

ring.what: the Ring echo under sg: glow pointer 2 .7 sg, the rest .25 sg; intensity + .45 sg; aura + .8 sg. The pointers' omen jerk (menu.js:632) runs on the demo clock only (D.p): with demo=0 (idle and story) they do not jerk (SPEC §8.3 text is the demo)

keystone.what: the Puzzle's eye gutters: eye x (1 - .95 win(omenU, .2, .32, .5, .7)) and comes back (v5: no flare)

rungs.cracksDoNotReact: CRACKS §3: no crack reacts to the ladder (the omen bolts are their own strikes, not a crack break)

bolts.what: the omen's black lightning (lore l.60): strike i from CRK.schedule(931, 0, .3, .42, 1500) (== P2 cracks_menu_<lay>.json schedules.omenBolts), path blPath(i) (fixed per strike), alpha blEnv(tc - t_i) eIO(clamp(sg / .85)) .95, drawn with CRK.drawBolt (P2 BoltGraphic: 6 k rgba(43,23,69,.7 a), 4.4 k rgba(58,31,94,.55 a), 3.2 k rgba(4,1,8,.97 a), round caps, miter 3) over the smoke, clipped to the Stone minus the breach (mask stone_minus_breach); tc = the crack clock (P2 crackTime, the stutter holds it)
bolts.env: blEnv(u) = 0 outside 0 <= u <= .66; eIO(u / .1) to .1; 1 to .24; 1 - eIO((u - .24) / .42) after
bolts.wrap: DECISION: the page's 1500 strikes end at tc 539.27 s (~9 min of page clock); Unity wraps tc mod 539.6 (last strike + .33) so a menu left open longer keeps its lightning
bolts.flash: strike starts: max 4 in any 1 s window (gaps .30-.42 s); thin dark lines, measured 0 flash frames on the approved cuts (check/flash.json): kept as approved

Scale = px / book px (always <= 1). In the idle the blinks play by time at 60 fps as P1's EyeFlipbook (1/60 s quantisation .03-.05 at mid-blink)
eyes.place: the page calls eye61Draw(g, x, y, px, st): the frame's anchor (cell px) sits at (x, y) and the cell scales by px / book px about it; rot is baked per book (11: -.08, 12: .3, 13: -.5, 0 for 23 / fissure). Breach eyes: x, y, px come after the .8 wrapper (anime_v61_eye.js:204): bx = x + B0 px, x' = bx - B0 px .8 (B = eyeGeo.B); the master eye about H.c (geo.breachC) x grow

eyes.trace: research side: out_p5/raw/land/idle/trace/*.json.gz and dread/trace/demo.json.gz (every eye call at 30 Hz: x, y, px, M, ga, st, S), dread/books2/states.json (60 Hz)

grade.use: alpha x d (out) / d (1 - spare) (in): canvas gradient alpha is linear in d. Draw order: P1 z 30+ (after the vignette, menu.js:675). The sky-lid hole is spared by a stencil: the grade images sit under a Mask whose graphic is the stage rect minus the current step's hole polygon (skylid.steps[].polygon, evenodd mesh); the bloom and the vignette DO reach the hole (check/skylid_vs_still.json: without the bloom the hole is 16 levels too dark). The crack breaks: CrackNets' through-the-dim copy over the grade (gaps at ea, the whole break at .35 ea) = the page's cut-outs

runes.use: each rune at (x + cos(an) rr .7, y + sin(an) rr .56 + 12 dis), an = -.92 pi + .31 i + .02 t, scale (1.3 - .3 cond), rotation an + pi/2, alpha .85 cond (1 - dis) clamp(7 cond - .7 i); glow additive, core over; the page's blur (2.5 + 3 dis / (1 - cond) 3 + 2 dis px) is baked at dis 0 / cond 1 (decided: the blur ramps are not reproduced)

skylid.stack: at the page's place (inside drawNutCracks: after the Nut fracture, P1 z 26, clipped to Nut's body): under (soot + torn flaps) -> realm (CrackNets RealmTile, drift, UV = stage px, inside hole_NN) -> band -> his eye (skylid_23 at track x, y, inside hole_NN) -> over (ink rim + lit sliver); then the bloom, pylons, vignette as usual; the grade skips the hole (grade.use)
skylid.step: op = eOut(clamp(DS.lid, 0, 1)); step = clamp(round(12 op), 1, 12) (12-frame hole sequence, BUILD_PLAN §6 P5); nothing when op <= .01
skylid.eye: his eye state: aU < 1.3 shut, < 2.45 the ep.1 open (aU - 1.3), then EYE61.blinkAt(aU, 2.45, 99); position = track (bx eases from +.7 to -.7 of (Wd - eyeW) / 2 over aU .9-2.8)
skylid.clip: the page draws it inside Nut's body clip (anime_v61_cracks.js:597); rebuilt from these parts over the approved stills (dread_04 13.6 s, portrait_02 13.6 s) the hole matches inside (land mean 3 levels with the bloom; port the medal DOM sits over the right tip): the body clip does not cut it (check/skylid_vs_still.json)
skylid.decision: the realm through the hole = the shared RealmTile route of the crack gaps (P2 CrackNets, drift 4 stage px / s there), not a frozen bake; the band and the rim are the page's own pixels at each step

refs.idle: research side: out_p5/raw/land/idle/refs/t*.png (the whole page at the omen / whisper beats, demo=0)
refs.story: research side: out_p5/raw/land/dread/vid/f*.png == hybrid/v6/work/vid_v6/dread (the approved menu_dread_demo source frames, max 0)

decisions: The ladder runs at the page's times (idle: omen 8 + 70 n + 20 hash2(n, 1, 3), whisper 34 + 70 n), not SPEC §8.3's "every 11 s from 5.2 s" (v2 / v3 text).
Every rung follows the page's formula (rungs.*.code); the Ring's pointer jerk is demo-only on the page, so the idle / story show none.
His eye ships as flipbooks at the dread sizes (D20): the 4-layer UmbraxEyeRig is NOT needed (every state the idle and the story draw is within .01 of a frame; check/dread_model.json).
Breach eye books are unclipped; the hole clip is a runtime mask (the eyes grow about H.c past the idle clip).
The omen strikes wrap at ~539.6 s of crack clock (the page has 1500).
Strike starts reach 4 in a 1 s window (plan: "<= 3 /s"): kept as approved (thin dark lines; 0 flash frames measured).
The sky-lid hole: 12 steps, the realm through it = the RealmTile route; the grade skips the hole by a stencil mesh (stage minus the step polygon), the bloom / vignette reach it as on the page.
The rune blurs are baked at their sharpest (dis 0, cond 1).
Cel smoke density at 1/2 stage res; the P1 smoke plate stays as the Battery Saver plate.
Battery Saver (SPEC §8.7): no omen lightning, no sky-lid, the ladder's grade / torch / Stone darkening keep their end-state timing at 30 fps, the smoke is the P1 plate.
